reuse.why: All six providers share the new link guards and reuse findOrCreateBank, syncAccount and handleSyncResponse, although local unlink cleanup is copied.

duplication.why: Fintegra adds another copy of the account-link workflow and transaction-download protocol, while replacement duplicates unlinkAccount's local cleanup.

placement.why: Link policy, request orchestration, provider transport, configuration and model definitions remain in their established modules.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the four requested linking changes and Fintegra integration.

maintainability.why: Shared guards centralize policy, but a mutating assertion with a positional replacement flag and duplicated workflows makes future changes harder to reason about.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Existing shared linking and sync helpers are used; unlinkAccount includes provider removal, so it is not a suitable abstraction for replacement's local-only cleanup.

disguised_duplication.where: sync.ts: downloadFintegraTransactions reshapes the existing authenticated transaction-request, error-handling and response-normalization sequence into a direct return.

abstraction_drift.where: link.ts: assertAccountNotLinked gains replaceExistingLink and a replacement branch that mutates the previous account, changing an assertion into a command; all six linking handlers still use it.
